# PalmCraft Cabinets

> PalmCraft Cabinets is a cabinet manufacturer in Oldsmar, FL that designs, builds, and installs custom cabinetry for homeowners across Tampa Bay, with no middleman. Free 3D design; custom kitchens start from $10,000.

- 4.9 ★ on Google: Average from 34 Google reviews
- From $10,000: Custom kitchens, quoted upfront
- Up to 6 weeks: Production time

- 20+ years: Experience

## Services

- **[Custom Kitchen Cabinets](https://palmcraft.co/services/custom-kitchens/)**: Made-to-measure kitchen cabinetry in two directions: American classic shaker or European modern flat-panel, including handleless designs. Every cabinet is sized to your room, appliances, and storage needs. You choose the door style, material, color, texture, and every handle, so your kitchen turns out exactly the way you pictured it.
- **[Outdoor Kitchens](https://palmcraft.co/services/outdoor-kitchens/)**: Outdoor kitchen cabinetry built from durable, weather-resistant materials for year-round Tampa Bay sun, rain, and humidity, laid out around your grill and appliances. You choose the layout, finish, and color, planned around your grill, fridge, and sink.
- **[Walk-In Closets](https://palmcraft.co/services/walk-in-closets/)**: Custom walk-in closet systems with drawers, hanging zones, shelving, and accessory storage planned around your wardrobe, from floor to ceiling. You choose every drawer, shelf, and hanging zone, plus the finish and hardware.
- **[Bathroom Vanities](https://palmcraft.co/services/bathroom-vanities/)**: Custom bathroom vanities built to the exact width of your bathroom, in single, double, or floating configurations, with storage and finishes matched to the room. You choose the size, configuration, finish, and hardware for your bathroom.
- **[Wood Stair Treads](https://palmcraft.co/services/stair-treads/)**: Custom wood stair treads and risers made to measure in White Oak or Ash, as solid, overlay, bullnose, or floating treads, so stairs match the rest of your interior. You choose White Oak or Ash, the tread profile, and the stain to match your floors.
- **[Decorative Wall Panels](https://palmcraft.co/services/wall-panels/)**: Decorative wall panels and design surfaces that tie cabinetry, TV walls, and feature walls into one consistent look. You choose the finish and layout to match your cabinetry, TV wall, or feature wall.
- **[Pantry & Laundry Cabinets](https://palmcraft.co/services/pantry-laundry/)**: Custom pantry and laundry room cabinets with pull-outs, adjustable shelving, and storage built around your washer, dryer, and the way your household shops and cooks. You choose the shelving, pull-outs, finish, and hardware for the way your home runs.

Timeline: Estimate within 24 hours → 3D design free, before you commit → Production up to 6 weeks → Installation by our own team.

## Solutions

- **Kitchen Remodel** (for homeowners replacing dated or worn-out cabinets): We measure your existing kitchen, rework the layout where it helps, and replace builder-grade cabinets with custom ones made to fit, so the new kitchen works the way you cook.
- **New Home & Custom Build** (for families building or buying new construction): We work from your plans and coordinate with your builder, so cabinetry for the kitchen, closets, and baths is designed together and ready when the house is.
- **Condo & Townhome** (for owners of condos, townhomes, and smaller spaces): Compact kitchens need every inch to count. We design storage around tight walls and appliances, and plan delivery and installation around your building's access rules.
- **Rental & Vacation Home** (for investors and owners of short- and long-term rentals): Durable finishes and practical layouts that handle heavy use and turnover, at factory-direct prices, with production up to 6 weeks to keep vacancy short.

## Peace of mind

- **Will it take forever?** We build in our own Oldsmar shop, so we never wait on a supplier. Production takes up to 6 weeks after you approve the design.
- **Will the price creep up?** You get an itemized quote before anything is built. What you sign is what you pay.
- **What if the company disappears mid-project?** You can visit our workshop by appointment only. You pay in stages, and the last 20% is due only after installation.
- **Will they actually listen to me?** Our designer walks you through every choice and shows it in 3D. Two rounds of design changes are included, and we work alongside your own designer if you have one.
- **Will I be able to reach anyone?** During business hours we call back within minutes. Every project gets its own WhatsApp group, so you always know where your cabinets are.
- **Will the rooms match each other?** Kitchen, TV wall, closets, and baths are designed as one system by one team, so finishes and details match across the whole house.

## Process

1. **Request & Consultation**: Send the short form or call. We discuss your room, style, and budget, and you get a response within 24 hours. The estimate is free and carries no obligation.
2. **Measurements & Design**: We measure your space for free, review the layout, and prepare a free 3D design with materials, colors, and hardware for your approval.
3. **Production**: After final design approval and the first deposit, production takes up to 6 weeks. Cabinets are ready for your inspection before delivery.
4. **Delivery & Installation**: PalmCraft delivers and professionally installs its own cabinetry across Tampa Bay, finishing with a hardware check and cleanup.

## Pricing

- Custom kitchens start from $10,000; every project gets an itemized quote upfront.
- Price depends on: Size of the room and total cabinet run; Door style: American shaker or European flat-panel; Materials, colors, and finishes; Organizers, pull-outs, and specialty hardware; Installation scope and site conditions.

## For professionals

- **Architects**: Send plans, elevations, or specs and we produce cabinetry to your design intent in our Oldsmar shop, with field measurements verified on site before production.
- **Developers & Builders**: We work on custom homes and renovations as your cabinetry trade partner: help with client selections and layouts, itemized pricing with installation included, and production up to 6 weeks.
- **Interior Designers**: Send us your client's vision and we handle the cabinetry design, 3D, and production, so you don't have to draw cabinets by hand. Built in the colors, finishes, and hardware you specify.

## FAQ

### How much do custom kitchen cabinets cost in Tampa?
PalmCraft custom kitchens start from $10,000. The final price depends on the size of the kitchen, the door style, materials and finishes, and accessories. You receive a full itemized quote upfront, with no hidden fees, after a free consultation.

### How long does a custom kitchen take?
Production takes up to 6 weeks from final design approval and the first deposit. Delivery and installation are scheduled after you inspect the finished cabinets. Your timeline is confirmed in the contract.

### What warranty do you offer?
PalmCraft provides a 24-month warranty. Full warranty terms are included in your customer contract.

### How does payment work?
The standard schedule is 50% deposit to start production, 30% when cabinets are produced and ready for inspection, and 20% after full delivery and installation. PalmCraft accepts credit card, Apple Pay, and ACH transfer.

### Do you offer financing?
Financing is not currently available. PalmCraft is working on adding it; ask during your consultation for the latest status.

### Do you install the cabinets?
Yes. PalmCraft delivers and professionally installs its own cabinetry throughout Tampa Bay. If you have your own contractor, PalmCraft can also manufacture and deliver cabinets for self-installation.

### Can you install cabinets I bought somewhere else?
No. PalmCraft installs only cabinetry it designs and supplies, so that the quality and warranty stay under one team's responsibility.

### What cabinet styles do you make?
PalmCraft works in two main directions: American classic shaker and European modern flat-panel, including handleless designs. Sizes, colors, finishes, and hardware are custom to your project.

### What areas do you serve?
PalmCraft serves Tampa Bay from its Oldsmar workshop, including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Palm Harbor, Largo, and nearby communities. Projects in Sarasota, Miami, and other parts of Florida are possible depending on order size and scope.

### Is the estimate free?
Yes. The in-home measurement, consultation, estimate, and 3D design are free with no obligation. Send the form or call (813) 565-3209 and PalmCraft will respond within 24 hours.

### How quickly do you respond?
During business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM) PalmCraft calls back within minutes. Simple questions are answered within the hour and detailed ones the same day, and every project gets its own WhatsApp group.

### Can you work with my interior designer?
Yes. Our designer works alongside your designer, not instead of them, and handles the cabinetry drawings, 3D design, and production.

### How many design changes are included?
Two rounds of design changes are included in the price, and you review everything in 3D before production starts.

### Can you do the whole house, not just the kitchen?
Yes. PalmCraft designs the kitchen, pantry, laundry, closets, vanities, TV wall, and stair treads as one system, so finishes and details match from room to room.

### Where are you located and when are you open?
PalmCraft's workshop and appointment location is at 343 Douglas Rd E, #1, Oldsmar, FL 34677. Hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Visits are by appointment only.

## Service area

Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Oldsmar, Brandon, Westchase, Palm Harbor, Largo, Wesley Chapel, Lutz. Also Sarasota, Miami, other Florida cities, depending on project size.

## Projects

- [Pompano Project](https://palmcraft.co/projects/pompano-project/): A waterfront home package: a walnut wet bar with lit glass display cabinets and a black stone counter, an outdoor kitchen and bar under the lanai, and a full-height backlit quartz feature panel framed in walnut.
- [St. Pete Kitchen, Pantry & Laundry, St. Petersburg, FL](https://palmcraft.co/projects/st-pete-kitchen/): A whole-house cabinetry package: a white inset-panel kitchen with a sage-green island, a white plaster-style hood, panel-ready built-in refrigerator, and a full-height quartz backsplash, plus a matching sage-green pantry and laundry room with open shelving, a hanging rod, and a folding counter over the washer and dryer.
- [Ruskin Kitchen, Ruskin, FL](https://palmcraft.co/projects/ruskin-kitchen/): A modern two-tone kitchen: matte light-gray handleless lowers and a tall oven wall, natural oak flat-panel uppers, and a blue-gray quartzite waterfall island with a matching full-height backsplash and under-cabinet lighting.
- [Modern Kitchen & Media Wall](https://palmcraft.co/projects/modern-kitchen-media-wall/): A dark flat-panel kitchen with a thick black marble island, lit glass display cabinets, and a wine wall, plus a matching living-room media wall with backlit slatted shelving and a built-in fireplace.
- [Kitchen, Bar & Home Office, Orlando, FL](https://palmcraft.co/projects/orlando-kitchen-bar-office/): A whole-home cabinetry project designed as one system: a two-tone oak kitchen with a marble waterfall island, a paneled refrigerator wall, a wine bar, and a built-in office nook.
- [Kitchen & Two Bars](https://palmcraft.co/projects/white-gray-kitchen-bars/): A bright two-tone kitchen with white uppers, gray lowers, and a marble waterfall island seating six, plus a gray wet bar with glass-front cabinets and a warm wood bar upstairs.
- [European Handleless Kitchen](https://palmcraft.co/projects/euro-handleless-kitchen/): White gloss uppers over charcoal handleless lowers, a white quartz waterfall island with seating for three, and a built-in wine fridge, in a modern European flat-panel style.
